label: salt formation 30ns, guidance recovery vs short-MD covered length with 6 prefix statistics, K15 base

length_definition.unit: covered length (ns), same definition as L01/L02; prefix = frames 0..(L/0.1) of the 0-1 ns history, 100 ps spacing

base.name: K15 base: train 58 / test 30 proteins, static 5 features, HistGBM (120 iters, lr 0.075, 31 leaves, min_samples_leaf 15, L2 0.02, seed 42) retrained per condition; history features per covered length = 6 statistics of the prefix (first, mean, std, min, last-first, fraction <= 4.0 A); full_history = static + the same 6 statistics over all 11 frames

bootstrap.resampling_unit: protein (30 test proteins, resampled with replacement)
bootstrap.note: Bootstrap intervals are computed for the 6-statistics curve. Within each resample, static-only, full-history and prefix-stats6 AUPRCs are recomputed from the saved per-candidate predictions and the gain and recovery are recomputed inside the sample. Models are not refit. Pooled AUPRC uses a numpy implementation of sklearn average_precision_score (threshold-grouped), verified against sklearn to <1e-9 on the full test set for every bootstrapped condition. Intervals for the mean-only curve are in L30.
